children: Zen Technologies reported a 50.7% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹90 crore for the second quarter of FY27, compared to ₹59.4 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Revenue nearly doubled, rising 99% year-on-year to ₹345.1 crore from ₹173.6 crore in Q2 FY26.
Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) increased to ₹132 crore from ₹65 crore in the year-ago quarter. EBITDA margin improved to 38.2% from 37.3%.
The value of orders on hand for the group stood at ₹1,375.70 crore as of September 30, 2026.
Shares of Zen Technologies ended 1.83% lower at ₹1,592 on the NSE on October 30.

title: Zen Technologies Q2 results: Net profit rises 51%, revenue nearly doubles to ₹345 crore
